summary: Evening bulk-embedding upload triggers KV-cache lock contention and upstream panics, causing elevated 5xx floor
description: Issue summary: Beginning 2026-03-10 18:05 UTC ClarionMaps reported a sustained increase in 5xx responses for embedding endpoints. Error rate rose from baseline ~0.2% to ~6% during a 45m window, with a persistent elevated error-floor (~1.2%) for several hours after the initial burst. Impact: customer embeddings API degraded causing failed batch imports and client-side retries. Environment: prod, us-west region, traffic routed via api-gateway cluster agw-usw-2 to serving-runtime pool srw-usw-3.
steps_to_reproduce: 1) Submit a single large embeddings bulk upload (10k items, many short texts) to /v1/embeddings with concurrency ~80 and request body size ~120MB
2) Observe a rapid increase in concurrent kernel allocations on serving runtime nodes pinned to open-embedding-large-v2
3) Watch KV-cache lock acquisition times spike and API responses begin returning 500/503/502
4) Retries from client cause amplified connection churn and a persistent error-floor even after load subsides
observed_behavior: API gateway returned 502/503/500 at the apigw layer with upstream 'connection reset' and 'upstream unhealthy' messages
Serving runtime processes logged repeated panic and watchdog restarts (SIGABRT) correlating with GPU preemption and CL context eviction on a subset of nodes
KV-cache (prefix index) reported long lock hold times and frequent lock contention metrics (kv.lock.wait_ms median increased from 2ms to 180ms)
Autoscaler reacted by spinning new nodes but warmup time and prefetch caused additional thrashing
logs_and_error_snippets: 2026-03-10T18:12:03Z srw-usw-3 node-17 runtime[pid:22411]: panic: unexpected nil pointer during kv cache fetch
2026-03-10T18:12:04Z srw-usw-3 node-17 runtime[pid:22411]: runtime stack trace ...\n  goroutine 321: ...\n  kv/cache.go:412 acquireLock(0x7f3b...)
2026-03-10T18:12:05Z apigw-usw-2 proxy: upstream reset while reading response headers from upstream\n  upstream: 10.4.78.22:8080
Metric snapshot (18:10-18:20 UTC): 5xx_rate=6.1%, kv.lock.wait_ms_p95=420, runtime-restarts=8, gpu-preemptions=3
investigation_notes: 18:15 UTC: Support (Priya) alerted SRE on #support and opened this ticket after initial ClarionMaps report.
18:18 UTC: SRE (Ethan) confirmed elevated apigw 502s, traced to routing to srw-usw-3 pool nodes showing runtime restarts.
18:25 UTC: Correlation found between ClarionMaps bulk-job bursts and sudden KV-cache hot-locks on a subset of partitions (partition id range 1024-1280).
18:33 UTC: Observed retries from client increased connection churn; autoscaler added 4 nodes but prefetch + model initialization increased load and cold-start memory pressure.

18:45 UTC: Applied temporary rate-limit rule for ClarionMaps tenant at edge (conn/concurrency cap = 40) which reduced immediate 5xx spike; error floor persisted at ~1% for 30m after due to cache thrash and pipeline recovery.

19:30 UTC: Eng runtime team confirmed a bug in KV-cache lock path under heavy concurrent prefix invalidation that can cause lock inversion and long hold times (internal issue created: github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/issues/9876).

20:10 UTC: Deployed emergency mitigation (kv-cache backoff tuning and lock timeout enforcement) to a canary subset of runtime pool; saw p95 lock wait drop from 420ms to 12ms on canary nodes and 5xx rate drop to ~0.6% for that slice.

21:00 UTC: Gradual rollout of mitigation across us-west serving pool completed; customer notified and asked to retry imports. Monitoring shows stabilization but a small residual error-floor remains while background prefetch eviction completes.
hypothesis: Primary: Large concurrent embedding bulk uploads triggered concentrated hot-key access patterns in KV-cache partitions, causing lock contention that blocked request handling goroutines and cascaded into runtime panics under memory pressure.

Secondary: Client retry amplification and autoscaler cold-starts amplified resource pressure, leading to intermittent GPU preemption and runtime process restarts, producing upstream 502/503 responses at the gateway.
temporary_workaround: Applied tenant-level connection/concurrency cap (conn cap 40) at edge for ClarionMaps and increased kv-cache lock timeouts plus backoff on lock acquisition. Recommended customers stagger large bulk-upload jobs and use smaller batches (<=1k items) until fix is rolled out.
resolution: Mitigation rolled to canary then full us-west pool: updated kv-cache lock backoff and introduced lock acquisition timeout with graceful fallback to a soft-cache-miss path. Runtime crash target fixed by guard against nil pointer during cache fetch (runtime PR merged: github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/4221). Monitoring shows 5xx back to baseline by 2026-03-11 02:15 UTC for us-west.
postmortem_followup: Create a throttling guidance doc for large embedding bulk imports and add to public docs and quickstart (owner: Devex, due 2026-03-20)
Implement tenant-level adaptive batching to detect hot-key patterns and automatically shard KV-cache keys to reduce single-partition contention (owner: Serving Runtime team, epi: INT-4021)
Add pre-deploy chaos test that simulates large concurrent embedding uploads to catch regressions in lock paths (owner: QA, due 2026-04-05)
Add an alert rule for kv.lock.wait_ms_p95 > 200ms in any region (owner: Observability)
Customer CS follow-up: ClarionMaps to receive incident summary and recommended import best practices; offer 2 weeks of Dedicated throughput credit for remediation impact (owner: CS)
